datasets.name: ds_banner
queryLines:
-- One row: is the live table fresh? Stale when its last refresh (the newest loaded_at) is over 90 minutes old.
WITH s AS (
  SELECT max(loaded_at) AS refreshed,
         coalesce(unix_timestamp(current_timestamp()) - unix_timestamp(max(loaded_at)) > 5400, true) AS stale
  FROM latest_readings
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN stale THEN 'stale' ELSE 'live' END AS state,
  CASE
    WHEN refreshed IS NULL THEN 'Live data is stale: no refresh yet. Every station shows no recent reading.'
    WHEN stale THEN concat('Live data is stale: last refresh ',
      date_format(convert_timezone('Asia/Singapore', refreshed), 'd MMM HH:mm'),
      ' SGT. Every station shows no recent reading until the next refresh.')
    ELSE concat('Live data: last refresh ', date_format(convert_timezone('Asia/Singapore', refreshed), 'd MMM HH:mm'),
      ' SGT, ', CAST(CAST(floor((unix_timestamp(current_timestamp()) - unix_timestamp(refreshed)) / 60) AS INT) AS STRING),
      ' min ago.')
  END AS message
FROM s

datasets.name: ds_streams
queryLines:
-- One row per stream: the newest reading, and the stations with a reading in the hour before the last refresh
-- (0 when the table is stale). 'of' counts the stations with a reading in the 24 hours before the refresh.
WITH s AS (
  SELECT max(loaded_at) AS refreshed,
         coalesce(unix_timestamp(current_timestamp()) - unix_timestamp(max(loaded_at)) > 5400, true) AS stale
  FROM latest_readings
),
m AS (SELECT * FROM VALUES ('wbgt', 'WBGT', 1), ('rainfall', 'Rainfall', 2),
      ('air_temperature', 'Air temperature', 3) AS v(measure, stream, ord)),
r AS (
  SELECT m.stream, m.ord, max(t.reading_ts) AS newest,
         count(CASE WHEN NOT s.stale AND unix_timestamp(t.reading_ts) > unix_timestamp(s.refreshed) - 3600 THEN 1 END)
           AS reporting,
         count(CASE WHEN unix_timestamp(t.reading_ts) > unix_timestamp(s.refreshed) - 86400 THEN 1 END) AS known
  FROM m CROSS JOIN s LEFT JOIN latest_readings t ON t.measure = m.measure
  GROUP BY m.stream, m.ord
)
SELECT stream, ord,
  coalesce(concat(date_format(convert_timezone('Asia/Singapore', newest), 'd MMM HH:mm'), ' SGT'), 'no recent reading')
    AS last_updated,
  CASE WHEN newest IS NULL THEN 'no recent reading'
    ELSE concat(CAST(CAST(floor((unix_timestamp(current_timestamp()) - unix_timestamp(newest)) / 60) AS INT) AS STRING), ' min')
  END AS age_now,
  concat(CAST(reporting AS STRING), ' of ', CAST(known AS STRING)) AS reporting_text,
  reporting, known
FROM r
ORDER BY ord

datasets.name: ds_wbgt
queryLines:
-- One row per WBGT station. Recent: a reading in the hour before the last refresh, and the table not stale.
-- The category is the API's own heat-stress field; a station without a recent reading is 'No recent reading'.
WITH s AS (
  SELECT max(loaded_at) AS refreshed,
         coalesce(unix_timestamp(current_timestamp()) - unix_timestamp(max(loaded_at)) > 5400, true) AS stale
  FROM latest_readings
),
w AS (
  SELECT t.station_id, t.station_name, t.lat, t.lon, t.value, t.heat_stress, t.reading_ts,
         NOT s.stale AND t.value IS NOT NULL
           AND unix_timestamp(t.reading_ts) > unix_timestamp(s.refreshed) - 3600 AS recent
  FROM latest_readings t CROSS JOIN s
  WHERE t.measure = 'wbgt'
)
SELECT station_id, station_name, lat, lon,
  CASE WHEN recent THEN value END AS wbgt,
  CASE WHEN NOT recent THEN 'No recent reading' ELSE coalesce(heat_stress, 'No category given') END AS heat_category,
  CASE WHEN recent THEN concat(format_number(value, 1), ' °C') ELSE 'no recent reading' END AS wbgt_text,
  concat(date_format(convert_timezone('Asia/Singapore', reading_ts), 'd MMM HH:mm'), ' SGT') AS reading_time,
  CASE WHEN recent THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS sort_group
FROM w
ORDER BY sort_group, wbgt DESC, station_name

datasets.name: ds_air
queryLines:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT max(loaded_at) AS refreshed,
         coalesce(unix_timestamp(current_timestamp()) - unix_timestamp(max(loaded_at)) > 5400, true) AS stale
  FROM latest_readings
),
a AS (
  SELECT t.station_name, t.value, t.reading_ts,
         NOT s.stale AND t.value IS NOT NULL
           AND unix_timestamp(t.reading_ts) > unix_timestamp(s.refreshed) - 3600 AS recent
  FROM latest_readings t CROSS JOIN s
  WHERE t.measure = 'air_temperature'
)
SELECT station_name,
  CASE WHEN recent THEN value END AS temp_c,
  CASE WHEN recent THEN concat(format_number(value, 1), ' °C') ELSE 'no recent reading' END AS temp_text,
  concat(date_format(convert_timezone('Asia/Singapore', reading_ts), 'd MMM HH:mm'), ' SGT') AS reading_time,
  CASE WHEN recent THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS sort_group
FROM a
ORDER BY sort_group, temp_c DESC, station_name

datasets.name: ds_rain_label
queryLines:
-- One row: the rainfall panel's heading, from window_end (one end time for all stations).
WITH s AS (
  SELECT max(loaded_at) AS refreshed,
         coalesce(unix_timestamp(current_timestamp()) - unix_timestamp(max(loaded_at)) > 5400, true) AS stale
  FROM latest_readings
),
r AS (
  SELECT max(window_end) AS window_end, count(value) AS with_value,
         count(CASE WHEN value > 0 THEN 1 END) AS wet, max(value) AS most
  FROM latest_readings
  WHERE measure = 'rainfall_last_hour'
)
SELECT CASE
  WHEN s.stale THEN 'Rain in the last hour: no recent reading (live data is stale)'
  WHEN r.window_end IS NULL
    THEN 'Rain in the last hour: no recent reading (no rainfall station reported in the hour before the last refresh)'
  ELSE concat('Rain in the hour to ', date_format(convert_timezone('Asia/Singapore', r.window_end), 'd MMM HH:mm'),
    ' SGT: ', CAST(r.wet AS STRING), ' of ', CAST(r.with_value AS STRING), ' stations with a reading recorded rain',
    CASE WHEN r.wet > 0 THEN concat(', up to ', format_number(r.most, 1), ' mm') ELSE '' END)
END AS label
FROM s CROSS JOIN r

datasets.name: ds_rain
queryLines:
-- Rain per station over (window_end - 60 min, window_end]. NULL (no reading in the window) and a stale table show
-- 'no recent reading', never 0 mm.
WITH s AS (
  SELECT max(loaded_at) AS refreshed,
         coalesce(unix_timestamp(current_timestamp()) - unix_timestamp(max(loaded_at)) > 5400, true) AS stale
  FROM latest_readings
),
r AS (
  SELECT t.station_name, t.value, t.n_readings,
         NOT s.stale AND t.window_end IS NOT NULL AND t.value IS NOT NULL AS has_value
  FROM latest_readings t CROSS JOIN s
  WHERE t.measure = 'rainfall_last_hour'
)
SELECT station_name,
  CASE WHEN has_value THEN value END AS rain_mm,
  CASE WHEN has_value THEN concat(format_number(value, 1), ' mm') ELSE 'no recent reading' END AS rain_text,
  CASE WHEN has_value THEN concat(CAST(n_readings AS STRING), ' of 12') END AS readings_text,
  CASE WHEN has_value THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS sort_group
FROM r
ORDER BY sort_group, rain_mm DESC, station_name

lines: The newest readings from NEA's real-time feeds: WBGT heat stress, rainfall and air temperature.
A scheduled job refreshes the readings (hourly at :05 SGT at present).
A station shows *no recent reading* when it has no reading in the hour before the last refresh, and every station does when that refresh is more than 90 minutes old.
Heat-stress categories (Low, Moderate, High) are NEA's own, as given in each reading. Times are Singapore time (SGT). Not official advice.

Contains information from NEA's WBGT, Rainfall and Air Temperature real-time datasets, accessed continuously from data.gov.sg, which is made available under the terms of the [Singapore Open Data Licence version 1.0](https://data.gov.sg/open-data-licence).
